pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v1.12
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
✨ New Features

[list]
[*] Bulk buying - New x1 / x5 / x10 / x25 / x100 / MAX buttons in the shop. The displayed cost shows the total for all purchases at once
[*] Passive click bonus - Each click now temporarily boosts your production by +10% for 5 seconds
[*] Animation speed slider - Adjust the game's animation speed from x0.25 to x3.00 in the settings menu
[*] Custom cursors - Unlock and equip pizza slice cursors from your Steam inventory (Cheese, Pepperoni, Golden, Purple)
[*] 4 new achievements - Track pizzas earned through clicking: 1K, 10K, 100K and 1M pizzas clicked
[/list]

🎨 Visual Improvements

[list]
[*] Stats, Collection windows are now draggable
[*] Consistent dark theme with gold borders across all windows
[*] Upgrade and Prestige buttons now reflect affordability and ascension state with color
[/list]

🐛 Bug Fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed the "Clicker" achievement threshold reduced from 100K to 50K clicks
[*] Fixed Golden Pizza timer position - now displayed correctly on screen
[*] Fixed achievements not syncing to Steam on game load
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.1
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a critical exploit where spamming the Ascension/Prestige button could open multiple panels simultaneously, allowing players to confirm multiple ascensions in seconds - leaderboard scores affected by this exploit will be reset with the arrival of Season 1 🍕
[*] Fixed tooltips getting stuck when hovering quickly over locked collection items
[*] Fixed the "Earn €1,000,000 with a single upgrade" achievement not unlocking correctly
[/list]
[h3]✨ New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] 4 new delivery skins: Ghost Rider, Tokyo Night, T-Rex Rider, Magic Carpet
[*] 2 new cursor skins: Rainbow Slice, Sea Slice

[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.5
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🏆 Season 1 - Now Live![/h3]
[list]
[*] Season 1 has officially started! It runs for 2 months, from March 28 at 1:00 PM UTC to May 28, 2026.
[*] 3 new exclusive Season 1 items are now droppable from the Pizza Box - the Season 1 Slice, Season 1 Scooter and Season 1 Plane. These items will only drop during Season 1, but remain tradeable forever once obtained!
[*] The Season 1 leaderboard is now live - scores reset and a new competition begins. Good luck! 🍕
[/list]

[list]
[*] The Easter event is now live! 3 limited Easter items are droppable from the Pizza Box - the Easter Slice, Easter Bunny Scooter and Easter Plane.

[/list]

[list]

[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.14
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:

[list]
[*] Halloween event from October 20 to November 3: spooky night theme, a pumpkin Golden Pizza, and Golden Pizzas show up more often.

[/list]

pending.contents:
